fix: eliminate process.env mutation in acceptance tests

The signup-guard test set SELF_HOSTED=true via process.env, which
poisoned all subsequent test suites in the same bun process — causing
447 test failures with "Registration is disabled".

Replace the env option on AcceptanceSuiteOptions with c

fix: remove 4-term cap from extractSearchTerms for OR-predicate queries

With OR-predicate BM25 queries (field @0@ $t0 OR field @1@ $t1 ...),
more terms = broader recall, matching embedding-era behavior where
every document got a similarity score. The 4-term cap was only needed
when stuck with AND m
